# Audio handoff

Record `audio/reading-script.md` for a complete reading, or read the excerpts in `production.json` / `video/STORYBOARD.md` for a discovery cut. Leave natural pauses; do not rush the reading to match the current preview duration.

Supply the original recording as WAV or another uncompressed master when available. Put the selected take at `audio/narration.wav` and update `chapter.json` only after checking it. No raw recording is present in this product set.

After delivery: select takes, align each storyboard beat to the recording, edit pauses, regenerate narration SRT/VTT from the actual words/timing, rebalance the ambience, render the 9:16 and 3:4 cuts, and review pronunciation, caption layout, audio peaks and playback. Current captions represent visual cards only.
